The correct answer is that Kathy is a pretermitted spouse: because Bill married her after executing his will and left lineal descendants who are not hers, she takes 50% of the estate despite the prenuptial agreement, Tommy takes the pasture land, and Tommy and Julie split the residue. The condominium deed to Kathy as estate by entirety does not change this result under the stated options.
CONFIDENCE: 80
